## Change

Describe what changed and which PS requirement it serves.

## Evidence

List commands, results, sample provenance, and known limitations. Do not include real identity documents, credentials or biometric data.

## Checklist

- [ ] Existing behavior and two user-facing branch names checked
- [ ] Tests or reproducible manual verification recorded
- [ ] `docs/CURRENT_STATUS.md` updated if capability claims changed
- [ ] No secrets, private records, unlicensed weights or datasets added
